empty.archive: Your future library. Park something and it will be here.
empty.search: Nothing kept matches. Showing open tabs and recently closed.

recovery.crashed: Chrome closed unexpectedly. Everything is safe — {asOf}.

error.capability: Ledge needs a browser capability that isn't available here.
error.refused: Ledge didn't do that, by design.
error.conflict: Undo would conflict with something that changed since.
error.durability: That change hasn't been confirmed safe yet.
error.format: That file isn't a format Ledge can read.
error.keys: The recovery phrase doesn't match this archive.
error.migration: An update couldn't finish moving your data.
error.output: The AI's answer came back in a shape Ledge can't use.
error.provider: The AI provider is unavailable right now.
error.quota: This device is out of storage space.
error.busy: Ledge is finishing earlier work first.
error.schema: Stored data arrived in a shape this version can't fully read.

recover.update: Updating Chrome usually restores it; your archive stays safe either way.
recover.restart: Restart the browser and open Ledge again; everything kept is safe.
recover.settings: You can change this in Settings, and nothing was altered.
recover.recovering: Ledge is already recovering from the journal; anything uncertain will be shown plainly.
recover.states: You can pick a different state instead; nothing changed.
recover.choose: Pick which version to keep — both are listed, nothing was dropped.
recover.retry: Give it a moment and try again; nothing has been risked.
recover.file-path: Check where it was saved, then pick it again.
recover.file-other: Use a Ledge export or supported browser data, and nothing was changed.
recover.keys: Check the phrase you saved during setup; local data is untouched.
recover.export: Export a copy first, then update; your archive is intact.
recover.recent: You'll find it in Recently Closed, ready to bring back.
recover.local: Ledge keeps working offline; results fill in when it's back.
recover.space: Free some space and everything continues; nothing kept is lost.
recover.wait: Wait a few seconds; nothing needs redoing.
recover.report: Report it and the data is preserved exactly; nothing is discarded silently.
